connector.name: three.ws Notifications
connector.registryDescription: Read the inbox, mark items read, manage delivery preferences, and register Web Push devices.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package notifications-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nirholas account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: THREE_WS_API_KEY
env.description: A three.ws API key (sk_live_… / sk_test_…) or OAuth access token for the account whose notifications you want to read and manage, carried as Authorization: Bearer. Required — every endpoint is account-scoped. Aliases: THREE_WS_TOKEN, THREE_WS_BEARER. Treat like a password.

env.name: THREE_WS_BASE
env.description: Base URL of the three.ws API. Override only when self-hosting or targeting a preview deployment.

env.name: THREE_WS_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for the live inbox reads/writes.
